description: This Java source file defines the GZIPResponseStream class, a custom implementation of ServletOutputStream that wraps and compresses HTTP response streams with GZIP compression, intended for response filtering in a web application.

classes.name: GZIPResponseStream
classes.description: A custom ServletOutputStream that compresses output streams using GZIP, managing in-memory buffering and stream finalization for HTTP responses.

methods.name: GZIPResponseStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the stream with the HTTP response and prepares for data buffering.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Finalizes compression, writes the compressed data to the response, and marks the stream as closed.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the buffer or gzips and sends it if the buffer exceeds a certain size.

methods.name: checkBufferSize
methods.description: Checks if buffered data exceeds the size limit and switches to streaming with GZIPOutputStream if necessary.

methods.name: closed
methods.description: Returns whether the stream has been closed.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Indicates that asynchronous operation is not supported; always throws an exception.

methods.name: setWriteListener
methods.description: Assigns a WriteListener for asynchronous IO, not supported here.
